subject: Acme Corp - Project Feedback
body:
Hi Sarah,

Just wanted to share some quick feedback on the project:

- The new dashboard features are excellent
- Our team loves the improved reporting
- Some users reported slow load times on the analytics page

Overall very happy with the progress. Let me know if you need any clarification.

Thanks,
Tom Brown
Product Director
